findings.problem: The conjugated verb sits outside the ICU arm and is fixed plural, while {visible} is a plain string (call site passes String(visibleTeams.length)), not plural-typed. With exactly one match the line renders “इस पेज की 5 टीमों में से 1 “abc” से मेल खाते हैं”, whose verb should be singular — and one match is a common search outcome. The plural arms themselves are correct (one/other; oblique टीमों after में से). Remedy: a label form that drops the conjugated verb — the same fix the fr round-1 audit used for this key.
findings.proposed: “{query}” से मेल: इस पेज की {total, plural, one {# टीम} other {# टीमों}} में से {visible}
